title: Rise & Fall achievement definitions
description: The achievement pool and the game-length setting that counts them. Each achievement is tied to one unit type and can be claimed by exactly one player for the whole game — the first player to simultaneously control their full per-player supply of that unit type claims it; it is then unavailable to every other player, even if they later also reach full supply.

gameLength.description: Players agree on a target at game start: how many achievements (summed across all players — not per player) must be claimed before the game ends. Once the target is reached, the round in progress finishes fully and then the game ends.

default.description: The standard game length in achievements, chosen if players don't pick a custom value.

min.description: Lowest game length players may choose.

max.description: Highest game length players may choose. Equal to the total number of achievements, since each can only ever be claimed once.

unitId.description: The unit type (matches an id in units.json) this achievement's supply condition is based on.

description.description: What earns the achievement, written from scratch.

victoryPoints.description: Victory points awarded to the claiming player. Placeholder value of 1 for every achievement until VP scoring is finalized.
